## v0.8.7 — App hide and commander alerts

**Settings → Apps** can hide apps from the header switcher and page dots. Settings itself cannot be hidden. Choices are stored in NVS. G0 still opens Recorder even when it is hidden.

Companion posts a notification when a Web or SSH run finishes. On success the truncated result body is included.

Voice playback uses the WAV sample rate so recordings no longer play too fast against the 48 kHz speaker default.

Firmware and Companion are both **0.8.7** (Companion versionCode 9).
